Najwa · Prayer times and quiet in one place
Najwa · Prayer first. Noise can wait.
Najwa helps you follow prayer times, receive adhan and iqama reminders, and silence your phone before restoring its previous ringer mode.
Najwa calculates prayer times on your device using the city and method you choose.
Check the times against your local calendar and set iqama delays to match your mosque. These are personal reminders.

We welcome your feedback and ideas
Review and send the prepared message from your email app.
Your data stays on your device

We store your city or coordinates, calculation method, appearance, and silence and alert preferences. We also keep a limited local history for ringer recovery, alert deduplication and schedule diagnostics.
The app does not request GPS location or read contacts, messages or other apps\' notifications.
When you select adhan audio, Najwa keeps a private copy and shares it with Android\'s notification player. Najwa does not request broad file access.
Najwa uses no Internet permission, accounts, ads or tracking. Prayer data and preferences stay on your device.
Contact opens your chosen email app. You choose what to send. Your email provider handles the message.
Ringer access lets Najwa set and restore silent mode. Exact alarms schedule reminders. Notification access displays them. Startup access restores the schedule after reboot.
The widget shows your city and prayer times on your home screen and requires no additional data access.
You can disable silent mode or alerts and revoke permissions. Clearing app data or uninstalling Najwa removes local data. System backup is disabled.
